_comment: Safety limits for planned arm moves. Positions in metres in base_link (x forward, y robot-left, z up). Review these before any live motion.

live._comment: Live sending. pose_cmd_convention must be set from evidence before anything is sent: 'relative_to_neutral' (like /{side}_arm/end_pose) or 'arm_base' (absolute link6 pose in {side}_arm_base_link). 'unverified' blocks all sending.
live._contact_2: 2026-11-22 11:21: an 18 N jump within 0.3 s at the START of a 1 cm move (acceleration in the estimate) stopped it. Readings are now median-filtered (3 samples) and the jump test skips the first contact_grace_s of each step.
live._contact: Stop on a sudden force jump (> contact_jump_n within contact_window_s) or a large total change (> contact_total_n). The force estimate drifts with pose (18 N over a long go-home on 2026-11-22), so a plain 15 N-from-start limit gave false stops.
live._pacing: Commands never lead the arm by more than max_lead (8 mm / 4 deg): the cartesian controller's jump detection (2 cm / 0.2 rad, alpha_scale 0.01) makes the arm crawl if a command gets further ahead. Seen 2026-11-22: a 12 deg pick step stalled 25 mm short.
live._evidence: 2026-11-22: robot recordings bag_logs/2026-11-05-14-04..14-40 (12 arm sessions, commands spanning 5-52 cm): arm followed pose_cmd within 1-4 mm median, 60-100 ms later, as relative_to_neutral; arm_base convention was off by 215-218 mm. Platform frame_id is empty.
